sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent painted animation cutout atlas for a cozy travel jigsaw. Make a TRUE transparent RGBA image, transparent space between subjects (no opaque backdrop, no paper rectangle, no glow, no grid, no checkerboard). Exactly FIVE independent watercolor/gouache cutouts arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, sixth bottom-right cell entirely empty. Every subject fully contained inside its own cell with very wide transparent gutters, nothing crosses halfway horizontal divider or any column divider. Keep each subject below 360px tall in 512x512 cell, centered. Soft hand-painted pigment and fine brushwork, warm gentle daylight from upper left, natural modest saturation; no text or UI. Subjects are detailed parts from a whole cozy illustrated scene, not stickers, no outline, no artificial rim or drop shadow. A turquoise camper awning beside a forest lake. TOP LEFT: a small fine horizontal ivory-white cloud wisp. TOP MIDDLE: a different small pale-white wispy cloud. TOP RIGHT: a narrow cream fabric ribbon tied in a small top knot, two hanging tails. BOTTOM LEFT: a fine deep-green rooted fern frond, bottom stem visible. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a tiny cluster of blue-white wildflowers on three short green stems sharing one bottom root. Five separate subjects, do not paint any landscape.
